library-entrance.name: Library Entrance Hall
library-entrance.description: The entrance hall of the Poznań Public Library. Bureaucratic posters decorate the walls, and the Archivist stands behind a glass counter.

archive-room.name: Central Archive Room
archive-room.description: A dark archive room filled with dusty books and towering files. The legendary Necronomicon is located somewhere here.

permit.name: Access Permit Form 12-B
permit.description: A signed permit form required to enter the central archives.

archive-key.name: Archive Key Card
archive-key.description: A plastic keycard used to unlock the archive gates.

necronomicon.name: The Necronomicon
necronomicon.description: An ancient forbidden book bound in leather, containing dark spells.

archivist.name: Mrs. Halina the Archivist
archivist.description: A strict librarian archivist who strictly follows library regulations.

dialogues.before_talk: Mrs. Halina: Hello. No one is allowed in the Central Archive without the official Access Permit Form 12-B. Bring it to me and I will grant you access.
dialogues.after_talk: Mrs. Halina: I am still waiting for the permit. Check the entrance desks, somebody might have left it there.
dialogues.after_satisfied: Mrs. Halina: Ah, yes. Form 12-B is in order. Here is the Archive Key Card. Do not stay inside too long.
dialogues.hostile: Mrs. Halina: Security! We have an unauthorized intruder!
